title: 30-case dataset + scorers + prompt experiments
acceptance_criterion: Every promoted case is traceable and held-out data has not influenced tuning
verdict: The traceability + contamination-control AC is genuinely met: frozen SHA, per-case reviewer/split, tuning on val only. Dataset card is a missing deliverable but not part of the AC.
evidence: fixtures/cases: 18 dev / 6 val / 6 held_out; each case has reviewer + source_refs + split
experiments/prompts-v1/{report.md,outcomes.jsonl}: 18 live runs (6 val x 3 prompt versions) on MiniMax-M3; v1_baseline + v2_structured selected; v3_minimal published as the unsuccessful change
tuning ran on val only; the held-out SHA check proves the held-out set was untouched
gaps: fixtures/cases/DATASET_CARD.md (planned in the step: family counts, per-case reviewer, acceptance/correction/duplicate rates) was not shipped.
All 3 prompt versions scored 0/6 task_success, so the 'promotion' of v1/v2 is by a coin-flip-equivalent margin; the selection rationale is qualitative (v3 has no system prompt), not metric-driven.

synthesized.note: The /dev-kit:build runner was never executed in this monorepo. The AgentOps Workbench was built in a standalone repo and imported via PR #8, so no per-step sub-agent subprocess output was ever captured. This file is an audit of the shipped tree under apps/agentops-workbench/ against the step's acceptance criterion, plus a re-run of the deterministic gates on 2026-09-11. status / acceptance_met are judgements against the code as merged, not a recorded process exit.

gate_rerun.cmd: cd apps/agentops-workbench && uv run pytest -q ; uv run ruff check .
